rulesNotes: 45 general education + 42 Professional Business Requirements + 18 area of study + 15 free electives = 120 semester credits.
The two selected Human Cultures choices are HIS-1140 and PHI-1300. Scientific category alternatives require independently published classification, not a course-title similarity.
The catalog label identifies the same receiving catalog as the existing exact course awards. This exact degree’s primary body, capture hash and 2026-11-27 review date are recorded separately.
The standard nonmilitary 15-credit eligible-course residency and 90-credit combined noncollegiate cap remain distinct. Cornerstone and capstone are taken at TESU.
At least half of the business area of study must be current within ten years of the most recent application date; the business capstone has a five-year currency limit.
